source_clause: HVS1. For Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats a press of the heated seat button turns the seat on HI, the soft button highlights red and the control displays 3 arrows, HI and/or LEDs (. The next button press sets the seat to MED, button remains highlighted and displays 2 arrows, MED and/or LEDs. The third button press sets the seat to LO, button remains highlighted and displays 1 arrow, LO and/or LED. The next press, turns the heated seat OFF, the button is no longer highlighted and 3 arrows are shown.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.1（HVS1）以四句定出 Multi-Level 加熱座椅之四段按壓循環及其指示，四個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：第八軸之 Multi-Level 值（字面即本節首句）；依 **R-C34** 第九／十二／十三軸與 EMEA 皆暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：與 `11.1` 同型之四段循環。刻意略過：**本節與 `11.1` 之唯一實質差異為 popup**（`11.1` 之首句有「opens popup」而本節無）—— **DR #11 之問句所指之三對即此**（另二對為 `11.2`↔`12.2`、`11.8`↔`12.1`）；依 63 §1.2 之指示，兩章之比對回**母節 full_text**，不以 037 之 leaf 描述代之（其描述省略主詞，`062-02`～`062-04` 與 `067-02`～`067-04` 逐字相同即其證）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第八軸「Standard vs Multi-Level 座椅」之值（功能型）；另與 `11.1` 為 章之別（ch11 `Heated Vented Seats` vs ch12 之同名條款）
distinguishing_axis.delta: **兩個判定**：(一) 對 `12.8`（SHVS1）—— 第八軸之 Multi-Level 與 Standard 兩值，段數（4 vs 3）與箭頭數（3 vs 2）皆異，**非等價**；(二) 對 `11.1`（HVS1）—— **唯一實質差異為 popup 片語**（`11.1` 有 `opens popup`，本節無），其餘三段逐字相同，故 `067-02`～`067-04` 與 `054-02`～`054-04` 之 TC 內容近乎相同而其 `test_item` 各自照錄母節（63 §1.2）。**兩章是否應合併即 DR #11**，本層不代答

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort section 之加熱座椅軟鍵與其指示
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: A press of the heated seat button sets the seat to HI
tcs.test_item: The system shall on a press of the heated seat button turn the seat on HI, with the soft button highlighted red and the control displaying 3 arrows, HI and/or LEDs
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats (12.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the heated seat button in the comfort section
2. Read the heated seat button and its control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The heated seat is on HI
2. The button is highlighted red and the control displays 3 arrows, HI and/or LEDs

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）
